goal: Die zwei historischen Sonderbranches release/i20-package und i21/visual-parity fachlich entscheiden und nur ihre noch nützlichen Muster als nicht-produktive Archivnotiz sichern

guide_delta.summary: Zwei alte, nie gemergte Branches werden nicht in den Produktcode übernommen. Nur wiederverwendbare Release- und UI-Prüfmuster sowie Herkunfts-SHAs werden dokumentiert.

tests_required: changed paths remain documentation/iteration metadata only
no product, runtime, CI workflow, database, schema or frozen-core path changes
tests_explicitly_not_run: product tests because no product code changes
database regressions because no database path changes
visual tests because no current UI is changed
risks: archive wording must not present historical I20 packaging as a current release path
historical I21 design values must not become accidental current UI requirements
non_changes: no runtime or product code changes
no cherry-pick or merge from either historical branch
expected_side_effects: useful historical release and UI quality patterns remain discoverable after later branch deletion
both special branches can be classified for deletion after this archive note is merged
